name: Arcade
description: Three lives. Every goal takes you to a harder free kick and refills your lives.

name: Weather Challenge
description: Gales, rain and snow. Puddles, skidding bounces and fumbling keepers.

name: Time Attack
description: 90 seconds on the clock. No lives - score as many as you can.

name: Target Challenge
description: Hit the boards hung in the goal for a 1,000 point bonus.

name: Sudden Death
description: One life. One miss and it's all over. How far can you go?

name: Bending Masterclass
description: Goals only count with at least 50% swerve. Double swerve bonus.

name: Night Match
description: Under the floodlights. Arcade rules on a cold evening.
